title: Taxation (Trustee Beneficiary Non-disclosure Tax) (No. 1) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would increase trustee beneficiary non-disclosure tax where trust income is distributed to a closely held trust's trustee without a correct trustee beneficiary statement.
It would raise the tax rate from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent, reflecting the proposed increase in the Medicare levy.
The change would apply from the 2014-15 income year and sit alongside companion bills adjusting other tax rates for the DisabilityCare Australia package.
changes: The non-disclosure tax rate under the No. 1 Act would rise by half a percentage point.
The rate calculation would incorporate a 2 per cent Medicare levy.
The revised rate would apply for 2014-15 and subsequent income years.
summary.affected: Trustees affected by the non-disclosure tax on distributions to trustees of closely held trusts without correct statements are affected.

speeches.speaker: David Bradbury
speeches.brief: Moved the Taxation (Trustee Beneficiary Non-Disclosure Tax) (No. 1) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, proposing that the trustee beneficiary non-disclosure tax rate rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014 to reflect the Medicare levy increase.

speeches.speaker: Jacinta Collins
speeches.brief: Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
